name: History of Dragosa
detailed_description:
History of Dragosa is a text-based choose your own adventure game where your choices write the lore of the world, choose between different fantasy classes and create characters and explore their stories while making choices to decide where their story goes. Once you complete a story you get to keep those books as you fill the in game library shelves. You can read them again or write new stories with different characters and make different choices to see all the multiple endings and outcomes. 

Choose Your Adventure

The next great story is up to you as you choose between Warrior, Wizard, Thief, or Cleric and decide their path through choices that explore branching narratives. These choices will determine the fates of your protagonists. Just like the adventure fantasy books where you can make choices to discover what happens next, History of Dragosa offers a virtual way to experience those wonderful tales.

Will you lead your protagonist to their untimely demise or will these heroes fulfill their epic quests? The choice is yours to make.

Create The History

Each story you create will be yours to keep, as each book is stored in the Castle Library, allowing you to read the previous adventures you've created. Fill the library shelves with the epic tales of your design. With these stories you can create the History of the fantasy world known as Dragosa.
